parameters.content:
## Dealers

Rows from ar_mock_dealers, narrowed by market, dealerId and city (accent-insensitive).

## Reservation

POST reservations: vehicle plus dealer give a reservation id that carries the dealer; a dealer without online booking answers dealer_not_dealerbook_enabled.

## Services and fulfilments

GET services and GET fulfilments of a reservation (POST on the lab): the catalogues, 404 for an unknown reservation id.

## Patch

PATCH reservations: the selected services, fulfilment or timeslot. Acknowledged with what was patched, not stored; 404 for an unknown reservation id.

## Timeslots

GET timeslots in fromDateTime..toDateTime; dealer from the reservation id or the request; deterministic from dealerId and date so tests repeat (the one Code node kept in the mocks).

## Book

POST bookings: required fields, then the FULL probe (409), then the DealerBook booking id and the six-letter reference code hashed from the idempotency key. Bookings persist in ar_mock_bookings.

## Bookings lookup

GET bookings by customerId, chassisNumber, offerId or status (POST on the lab); a referenceCode narrows to the spoken code.

## Cancel

POST bookings/{bookingId}: marks the booking cancelled.

## Reschedule

POST bookings/{bookingId}/reschedule: the booking keeps its id and reference code and gets the new timeslot; movedFrom records the old one.

## Mock DealerBook

Endpoints under ar-mock/dealerbook/* follow the API V2 lifecycle of the endpoint sheet (2026-10-23): a reservation (vehicle and dealer), its services and fulfilments, a PATCH per selection, timeslots in a window, then the booking. The reservation id carries the dealer so the mock stays stateless; a PATCH is acknowledged, not stored. A slotId containing FULL returns 409. Lookup keys are customerId, chassisNumber, offerId and status; a booking has a DealerBook booking id and a six-letter reference code. Bookings persist in ar_mock_bookings. Payload shapes are the mock's own until question 23 is answered.

meta.description: Lab stand-in for DealerBook API V2 in the order of the endpoint sheet (2026-10-23): dealers, POST reservations, GET services, GET fulfilments, PATCH reservations (services, fulfilment, timeslot), GET timeslots, POST bookings, bookings by customerId, chassisNumber, offerId or status, cancel, reschedule. Dealers in ar_mock_dealers, deterministic slots, bookings in ar_mock_bookings. Replace with the DealerBook API.
